translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Negikelo Sandug Muma mar Nyasaye mi gikete ei hema mane Daudi ogurone, bangʼe negitimo misengini miwangʼo pep kod misengini mag lalruok e nyim Nyasaye.
Kane Daudi osetieko chiwo misango miwangʼo pep kod misango mar lalruok, ne ogwedho jo-Israel ka oluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye.
Bangʼe ngʼato ka ngʼato ma ja-Israel, dhako kata dichwo nomiyo makati achiel, gi ringʼo mayom kod olembe motwo mongʼin.
Noyiero jo-Lawi moko mondo oti e nyim Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye, mondo olem kendo ogo erokamano ka gipako Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel.
Asaf ne jatendgi, Zekaria jalupne, kiluwogi kod Jeyel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Matithia, Eliab, Benaya, Obed-Edom gi Jeyel mane jogo orutu gi nyatiti ka Asaf to ne dwongʼo ongengʼo
to Benaya kod Jahaziel ma jodolo to ne goyo turumbete e sa ka sa e nyim sanduk singruok mar Nyasaye.
Zaburi mar Daudi mar goyo erokamano
Chiengʼno ema ne Daudi omiyo Asaf kod jowetene zaburini mar goyo erokamano ni Jehova Nyasaye kama:

content.text: Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye,
luonguru nyinge,
landuru ne ogendini duto gima osetimo.
Werneuru, pakeuru gi wende,
nyisuru kuom tijene duto miwuoro.
Nyinge maler nigi duongʼ,
chuny joma manyo Jehova Nyasaye mondo obed mamor.
Ranguru Jehova Nyasaye gi tekone,
dwaruru wangʼe kinde duto.
Paruru gik miwuoro mosetimo,
honni mage kod buche mosengʼado,
yaye, un nyikwa Israel jatichne,
yaye, un yawuot Jakobo joge moyiero.
En e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa;
buchene ni e piny duto.
Oparo singruokne nyaka chiengʼ,
weche mane osingo e tienge tara,
Singruok mane otimo gi Ibrahim,
muma mane okwongʼorego ni Isaka.
Ne ogure ne Jakobo kaka chik,
kendo nogure ni Israel kaka singruok mochwere:
Nowacho niya, “Anamiyi piny Kanaan kaka
girkeni mari.”
Kane pod gin ji manok e kar rombgi,
ne ginok ahinya kendo ne gin welo e pinyno,
ne giwuotho e kind ogendini mopogore,
ka gidhi e pinyruodhi mopogore opogore.
Ne ok oyie mondo ngʼato osandgi,
nokwero ruodhi kowachonegi niya,
“Kik umul joga ma awiro,
kik uhiny jonabi maga.”
Weruru ne Jehova Nyasaye un ji duto modak e piny,
landuru warruokne odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ.
Huluru duongʼne e kind ogendini
kendo landuru tijene miwuoro ne ji duto.
Nimar Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kendo owinjore gi pak;
onego omiye luor moloyo nyiseche mamoko duto.
Nikech nyiseche duto mag ogendini gin mana gik ma dhano oloso,
to Jehova Nyasaye ema nochweyo polo.
Duongʼ kod pak nitiere e nyime;
teko kod mor nitiere kar dakne.
Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, yaye ogendini manie piny,
wachuru ni Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ kendo en gi teko.
Miuru Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ mowinjore gi nyinge.
Keluru chiwo kendo ubi ire mondo.
Ulam Jehova Nyasaye e lerne marieny mar berne.
Un ji duto manie piny, beduru gi e nyime!
Piny osegur motegno kendo ok noyienge.
Polo mondo obed moil,
piny mondo obed mamor,
we mondo giwachne e dier ogendini niya,
“Jehova Nyasaye olocho!”
Nam kod gik moko duto man e iye bende omor,
beduru mamor un pewe kod gik manie iwu.
Bangʼe yiende manie bungu nower,
giniwer gi mor e nyim Jehova Nyasaye,
nikech obiro ngʼadone piny bura.
Gouru erokamano ne Jehova Nyasaye nikech ober;
kendo herane osiko manyaka chiengʼ.
Ywaguru niya, “Reswa aa Nyasaye ma Jawarwa,
chokwa kendo reswa kuom ogendini,
mondo mi wadwok erokamano ne nyingi maler
kendo wabed mamor kwapaki.”
Pakuru Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel
mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.

content: Eka ji duto nowacho niya, “Amin” kendo ni “Opak Jehova Nyasaye.”
Daudi ne oweyo Asaf kod jotich kaachiel kode e nyim Sandug Singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye mondo giti kanyo ndalo duto mana kaka ne dwarore pile ka pile kendo odiechiengʼ ka odiechiengʼ.
Ne oweyo bende Obed-Edom kod jowetene piero auchiel gaboro mondo joti kodgi. Obed-Edom wuod Jeduthun to gi Hosa bende ne jorit rangeye.
Daudi noweyo Zadok jadolo kod jowetene ma jodolo e nyim hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye e kama otingʼore gi malo man Gibeon,
mondo gichiwne Jehova Nyasaye misengini pile pile e kendo mar misango miwangʼo pep, gitim kamano okinyi kod odhiambo mana kaka ondikgi duto e Chik Jehova Nyasaye mano mi jo-Israel.
Kaachiel kodgi ne gin Heman gi Jeduthun kod joma moko manoyier kendo oluong gi nyingegi mondo gi dwokne Jehova Nyasaye erokamano, “nikech herane osiko manyaka chiengʼ.”
Heman kod Jeduthun to ne tijgi en goyo turumbete kod ongengʼo kod goyo thumbe mamoko mag wend Nyasaye. Yawuot Jeduthun to ne rito rangach.
Eka ji duto noa ka ngʼato ka ngʼato dok e dalane, kendo Daudi bende nodhi dalane mondo ogwedh joge.
